Let \(\phi\) be the central angle between the two base-circle endpoints. The chord length is
\[
AB=2r\sin\frac{\phi}{2},\qquad r=\frac53.
\]
Since the generatrices have length \(2\), the section is an isosceles triangle with equal sides \(2\), so its area is
\[
S=\frac12\left(2r\sin\frac{\phi}{2}\right)\sqrt{4-r^2\sin^2\frac{\phi}{2}}.
\]
Let \(x=\sin\frac{\phi}{2}\). Then
\[
S=\frac53 x\sqrt{4-\frac{25}{9}x^2}
=\frac59 x\sqrt{36-25x^2}.
\]
Maximize
\[
f(x)=x\sqrt{36-25x^2}.
\]
Squaring,
\[
f^2=x^2(36-25x^2).
\]
Let \(y=x^2\). Then
\[
36y-25y^2
\]
is maximized at
\[
y=\frac{36}{50}=\frac{18}{25}.
\]
Thus
\[
f_{\max}=\sqrt{\frac{18}{25}\left(36-18\right)}=\frac{18}{5}.
\]
Therefore
\[
S_{\max}=\frac59\cdot \frac{18}{5}=2.
\]
\[
\boxed{2}
\]
